entries.text: Drag a selection box to command your entire squad, or assign numbered control groups to split melee frontliners from casters.
Focus enemy shamans and weavers first; their firebolts and curses shred unwarded armor faster than pack beasts.
Keep mercenaries behind your hero's shield line when entering narrow bridges or ossuary choke points.
Hold position orders prevent archers and mages from chasing fleeing raiders into unlit ambushes.
Every spell draws on telluric pressure—watch your mana orb before committing to a prolonged engagement.
Drink healing draughts before your health drops below a third; burst damage from elite packs leaves little margin.
Compare newly looted gear against equipped pieces before selling—even common upgrades with higher armor save lives.
Salvage unwanted magic and rare gear at town smithies to stockpile essences for tempering and affix rerolls.
Equipping multiple pieces of a named regimental set unlocks passive bonuses that scale through the late campaign.
Socketed runes and quartz crystals turn ordinary weapons into reliable counters against elemental elites.
Check the tavern in every hub; mercenaries carry their own gear and can be revived for silver if they fall.
Tavern rumors shift as you advance across the four provinces—listen closely for warnings on upcoming bosses.
Morvessa's silk-brood thrives in tight corridors; lure hatchlings into open ground before using area spells.
Gorrathul's freeze aura slows swing speed and march pace—rely on ranged bolts and fire magic along the causeways.
Spread your company wide when facing Vesperion; his ball lightning arcs cleanly through bunched formations.
On the Obsidian Dais, watch Ashkarath's furnace vents and reposition before his fire ring closes.
Unlocking waypoints along the road lets you fall back to town for repairs and potions without losing map progress.
Field shrines grant temporary surges of haste, fortune, or ward power—save nearby ones until a tough fight begins.
Side crypts and undervaults hold denser chests and elite packs than the main highway, rewarding bold detours.
Frost spells slow charging boars, sand raiders, and cinderhorns, buying precious seconds for archers to fire.
Fire magic burns through bitumen-wrapped crypt embalmers and fungal spore matrons with heightened efficiency.
Lightning arcs crack mineral seams on basalt brutes, wardstone golems, and water-soaked coastal crabs.
Keep a few spare silver groats in reserve—smithing failures and emergency mercenary revivals drain purses quickly.
Skirmish maps let you test any saved commander against randomized terrain and enemy rosters without risking campaign state.
Export your save file from the roster screen regularly so browser storage resets never erase a veteran hero.
On touch devices, tap and hold to issue right-click move or attack orders, and pinch with two fingers to zoom.
High ground and bridge heads funnel melee swarms, letting a single armored vanguard hold off triple their number.
Do not let dune scarabs die in melee range if your squad is low on health; their cracked shells vent static.
Third-Dynasty Probate Debt Law binds indebted skeletons to their posts until the controlling crypt embalmer falls.
The twelve Quartz Wardstones of Redmarsh pin alkali dust storms down; repairing them clears visibility and eases travel.
In Oakhaven Harbor, whale-oil magazines fuel both lighthouse prisms and siege culverins—guard supply depots carefully.
Star-iron must be quenched within four heartbeats in caldera brine; forged relics carry unmatched heat resistance.
Respeccing skill points at town costs silver, allowing you to pivot from crowd-control to single-target boss hunting.
Elite monsters carry colored auras and special affixes—hover or inspect their nameplates before rushing in.
Vampiric elites heal off every landed strike; kite them with ranged units or overwhelm them with burst stuns.
A balanced squad pairs one sturdy frontline tank with ranged damage and a caster for elemental coverage.
Check the Hall of Relics Codex to track which unique artifacts and monster entries you have yet to uncover.
Raising difficulty to Veteran or Doomed sharpens enemy aggression in exchange for richer loot and higher-tier affixes.
Never ignore poison ticks in the Weeping Ossuary; green venom stacks steadily even after a spider-brood dies.
When fog of war hides a ridge, send a single scout forward rather than marching your wounded company blind.
Sound cues warn of off-screen ambushes—listen for gnoll horns, static hums, and heavy stone footsteps.
Unidentified crates sold by quartermasters are a gamble, yet occasionally yield rare-tier gear above your current zone.
Use attack-move orders when advancing through brushwood so your squad engages ambushers automatically.
Mercenary archers excel at picking off glasswings and storm kites that hover beyond melee sword-reach.
Every town hub stocks higher-tier gear than the last; revisit Thornwick, Redmarsh, Oakhaven, and Ironcamp as you level.
Tempering gear to +5 raises base stats noticeably, though failed strikes risk cracking low-tier scrap.
If a boss enrages, prioritize dodging telegraphed ground circles over landing one last greedy swing.
In Hardcore mode, death seals the ledger permanently—carry extra healing draughts and never fight cornered.
Download chapter packs ahead of travel so the entire campaign runs cleanly offline without mobile data.
The Crown of Order binds sovereigns to the Seven Anchor Seals; whatever you choose at the Threshold shapes Thornvael.
